title: Main board - J29 UART header: bench hookup (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)

callouts.label: J29 hole 1 (dot end), TP29 net
callouts.note: UART0 line A: the CC3220's TX or RX (meter decides, chapter 1). Listen: 4.7 kOhm to the FTDI RXD or ESP32 GPIO16. UARTLOAD: FTDI TXD via 1 kOhm if this is RX. The bottom hole; the pin-1 dot is printed left of it.

callouts.label: J29 hole 2, TP28 net
callouts.note: UART0 line B: the CC3220's TX or RX (meter decides, chapter 1). Listen: 4.7 kOhm to the FTDI RXD or ESP32 GPIO17. UARTLOAD: FTDI TXD via 1 kOhm if this is RX. The middle hole.

callouts.label: J29 hole 3, GND
callouts.note: FTDI GND / ESP32 GND (J-112). The top hole, '3' printed above it.

callouts.label: Test point, J29 hole 1 net
callouts.note: Rings to J29 pin 1 (beeper, J-112). Labelled; right of J29, below TP28.

callouts.label: Test point, J29 hole 2 net
callouts.note: Rings to J29 pin 2 (beeper, J-112). Its label sits above-left, partly in a stitching gap.

callouts.label: Series resistors toward U1 pins 55/57
callouts.note: Two 0603 between J29 and TP28/TP29; the labels R57x and R58x above them are partly in a stitching gap, so which is which is open. Toward U1 pins 55/57 (UART0 TX/RX in the SWAS035C pin mux): still to trace.
